title: 60000-keycloak: Update conf imports for keycloak provider
body:
Per [https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/60000], 

Update keycloack provider to stop importing conf from airflow.configuration and instead use the shared compat import
from airflow.providers.common.compat.sdk import conf.

files.patch:
@@ -59,7 +59,7 @@ requires-python = ">=3.10"
 # After you modify the dependencies, and rebuild your Breeze CI image with ``breeze ci-image build``
 dependencies = [
     "apache-airflow>=3.0.0",
-    "apache-airflow-providers-common-compat>=1.10.1",
+    "apache-airflow-providers-common-compat>=1.10.1", # use next version
     "python-keycloak>=5.0.0",
 ]
